text.p: Pen pictures of the likely PSV Eindhoven squad for Sunday's Dutch first division game against Feyenoord.
Ronald Waterreus. Goalkeeper. Age 26. Reliable but not a born leader.
Vampeta. Defender. Age 23. Fast with attacking spirit. His second spell at PSV. He was earlier loaned out to mature. His Brazilian way of playing sometimes causes panic in PSV's backline.

Jaap Stam. Defender. Age 24. Main man in centre of defence. Strong, tall, good header and quick. Has earned some caps as a replacement for Danny Blind or Stan Valckx in the Dutch national side and is still developing.
Stan Valckx. defender. Age 33. Experienced defender, good marker, but not the fastest. Has recently suffered a few small injuries.

Arthur Numan. Defender. Age 27. The PSV skipper started his career as attacking left midfielder and was switched to defence when PSV were short of left-footed players at the back. However, adds to attacking options by his frequent dashes up the line.

Wim Jonk. Midfielder. Age 30. The former Ajax player came to PSV from Inter Milan. Has found his old Ajax form again, bringing him back into the Dutch squad. He is a man with creativity and is the play-maker in midfield.

Marciano Vink. Midfielder. Age 26. Like Jonk, has experience in the Italian first division. However, has been injured several times for long spells. Now has to compete with Petrovic and Stinga for a place in the team.
Ovidiu Stinga. Midfielder. Age 24. PSV signed the Romanian just before the winter break from Spanish second division side Salamanca. Still has to impress his quality on wary PSV fans.
Marc Degryse. Midfielder. Age 31. The Belgian international came with compatriot Luc Nilis to Eindhoven. Started the season well, but has faded.

Zeljko Petrovic. Midfielder. Age 31. The flamboyant Yugoslav seemed to be heading for retirement at the basement of the Dutch league with RKC Waalwijk when he was signed to strengthen the squad. Has complained about lack of support from the coach, but few grumbles recently.

Boudewijn Zenden. Striker. Age 20. Left winger, by many seen as a great talent, but gets little playing time as he disturbs the balance in the team. Used mostly as super-sub. Combined soccer and judo until his 16th birthday and was three times youth judo champion in his home province of Limburg.
Philip Cocu. Midfielder. Age 26. Hard worker with a good shot. His defensive skills mean he is used on the left side of midfield to support the strikers.

Luc Nilis. Striker. Age 30. The Belgian international was the Dutch league's top scorer last season and heads the list again this year with 15 goals. Was named player of the year for 1996 in the Netherlands and Belgium in 1996. Good improvisor with a deft touch. He is also a free-kick specialist.

Marcelo. Striker. Age 23. The Brazilian striker has a hard task to follow compatriots Romario and Ronaldo. So far he has fallen short and PSV fans know it. Strong in the box, but very much in the shadow of Nilis, in both quality and character.
Chris van der Weerden. Defender. Age 24. Right side defender. Lost the battle for a regular place in the team to Vampeta. Mostly used to beef up defence, particularly when defending a lead.
Ernest Faber. Defender. Age 25. Good marker and header. Has suffered many injuries and has lost his regular place in the opening line-up. 051033 GMT mar 97
